about: Which sky each map gets, chosen by looking at the original's sky zone (its textures and fog): star boxes and dark blue skylines are clear nights, grey cloud and fogged-black skies are overcast nights, ClubE's orange skyline is dusk. 'kinds' holds each sky's settings: panorama (an HDRI of pbr_sets.json), rotation (degrees about the vertical), brightness (of the visible dome), stars (drawn star brightness, 0 = none), sky_light (strength of the light the sky throws), tint, and moon (the directional light: lux, colour, yaw and pitch in degrees; omitted = none). Maps not listed get 'default'.
